purpose: Standalone calendar surface for selecting one date or a date range.

notes: Use VeliProvider when the calendar must follow Veli language and text direction settings.

useWhen: Embed date selection directly in a scheduling, booking, filter, or availability surface.
Show constrained or unavailable dates while preserving calendar context.
Keep the selected or focused date synchronized with external state.

avoidWhen.situation: Date selection should remain compact until the user opens it.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use the field-style control with its calendar popover.

avoidWhen.situation: Users only need direct segment-by-segment date entry.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use the dedicated editable date field.

supportedInteractions: Select a single date or a start-and-end date range.
Navigate months and choose a year from the header.
Move keyboard focus within the calendar.
Block dates by minimum, maximum, or availability rules.
approvedPatterns: Provide an accessible name when no visible label describes the calendar.
Use controlled value and focus state when selection must stay synchronized with other UI.
Use RangeCalendar for start-and-end date selection.
Pair invalid state with a concise error message when guidance is needed.
limitations: The date grid defaults to 19.25rem and shrinks to fit its container.
The built-in Today action is opt-in.
Unavailable dates remain focusable but cannot be selected.
accessibility: Provide aria-label when there is no visible label.
Disabled and unavailable dates are visually distinguished.
Keyboard focus receives a visible focus ring.
Selected dates and range endpoints use white text and Today indicators in both themes, including invalid selections.
Weekday abbreviations expose full Dhivehi labels where available.
responsive: Use min-w-0 on flex/grid parents so the seven-column grid can shrink on mobile.
Place multiple calendars in one column on narrow layouts.
rtl: VeliProvider can supply Dhivehi locale and RTL direction.
Navigation icons reverse direction in RTL.
Range endpoints use logical start and end rounding.
